text:
julia: quick heads-up — our embed+rerank pipeline started failing in prod after the token-refresh rollout. seeing a dim mismatch when rerank helper runs, repro attached in logs. anyone seen this recently?

miguel: hmm, likely either a tokenizer/truncation change or a streaming buffer off-by-one. can you paste the exact error? :thinking: 

julia: paste from server log:```
ValueError: embedding dim mismatch: expected 1536, got 1535
  File "/app/rerank/batcher.py", line 212, in combine
    assert vec.shape[1] == expected_dim
```
Also the client side printed shapes as (24, 1536) before sending. SDK is py-sdk 0.14.2, we're using the streaming client to upload batched embeddings via send_chunk.

sasha: I saw something similar last quarter when we switched the quantized runtime — if the quantization packer drops a trailing element for odd-length buffers you can end up with a 1-off dim. are you using any custom postprocessing (trim/pad) on the vectors?

julia: no custom postproc. We do `np.array(e['vector'])` on the stream items and concat. Example simplified code:```python
# simplified
emb = client.embeddings.create(inputs=batch)
# streaming case
for e in emb.stream():
    out = np.array(e['vector'])
    print(out.shape)
```
The prints show (1536,) for most but occasionally (1535,). When rerank ingests the batch it errors.

miguel: two quick checks: 1) confirm dtype (float32 vs float16) — float16 rounding + tolist/numpy casts sometimes truncate trailing bytes if buffer view is misaligned; 2) verify model variant — v1 vs v1-quant can have different internal packing. Also check that your streaming assembler isn't concatenating partial vectors when a token refresh interrupts the stream.

pranav: small debugging tip: before concatenation, assert each vector length and log index: `assert len(vec) in (1536,)` or auto-pad: `vec = np.pad(vec, (0, 1536-len(vec)))` as a stopgap. But we should root cause. Can you capture the raw bytes for a failing item?

sasha: agreed — also add an integration test that simulates token refresh mid-batch. We had a bug where the client retry would re-request a partial chunk and the stream handler appended instead of replacing.

julia: good point — we are on a retry flow that does a re-stream of the last N items. I'll open an issue with a minimal repro and include the raw failing vector bytes. created issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/3724 (attached logs).

miguel: will take a look. If it's a client bug we should patch py-sdk. If it's server-side quantization packing, we'll coordinate with eng-runtime.

pranav: I can review a small PR to the embed-batcher. Suggest adding a lightweight assert and a sanitized pad fallback. i'll review this afternoon. @sasha can you add a test case in the embeddings-integ suite?

deploy-bot: deploy: rollout/redwood-embed-patch succeeded in staging at 2026-03-05T15:22Z :rocket:

julia: thanks all — I'll add the assert + pad fallback in a PR and link the issue. will ping again after I attach the raw bytes and the minimal repro. thanks :heart:
